nodes.description: Owner address stored in BotProtected, set to msg.sender in the Kattana constructor and used as the privileged access-control anchor.
Address of the external Ferrum launch-protection contract that is called by the checkBots modifier.
Uniswap pair address passed as an argument into the external bot-protection call.
Modifier that performs an unchecked low-level call to botProtection before the wrapped function body executes.
Constructor storing the bot-protection address.
Private balance mapping of the abstract ERC20 implementation, mutated through SafeMath.
Private nested allowance mapping of the abstract ERC20 implementation.
Private total supply variable of the abstract ERC20 implementation, changed by _mint and _burn.
Public ERC20 transferFrom that moves balances and decreases allowance.
Internal balance-moving routine using SafeMath sub/add on _balances.
Internal routine writing into the _allowances mapping.
Public ERC20 approve entry point delegating to _approve.
Public ERC20 transfer entry point delegating to _transfer.
View function reading the _balances mapping.
View function reading the _allowances mapping.
Increases spender allowance using SafeMath add.
Decreases spender allowance using SafeMath sub.
Internal mint that increases _totalSupply and a balance.
Internal burn that decreases a balance and _totalSupply.
View function returning _totalSupply.
Public balance mapping of the Kattana token, directly indexed and mutated with plain += and -=.
Public nested allowance mapping of the Kattana token.
Total supply constant-initialized to 1e25 and used for the owner allocation in list().
Hard-coded Uniswap V2 router interface used to add liquidity.
Hard-coded WETH address used to compute the Uniswap pair.
Constructor that sets owner, computes uniPair and grants infinite allowances.
Public payable transfer that forwards to transferFrom with msg.sender as sender.
Main public payable transferFrom, guarded by the checkBots modifier and performing unchecked allowance/balance updates.
Public payable approve writing directly into the allowance mapping.
Owner-only function executing an arbitrary delegatecall payload.
Internal pure function computing the Uniswap pair address via CREATE2 hashing.
Owner-only listing function writing balances, calling addLiquidityETH and airdropping tokens.
Caller-controlled address used for authorization checks, allowance spending and balance writes.
Miner-influenced timestamp used to build the Uniswap deadline in list().
Raw low-level call with abi.encodeWithSelector to an arbitrary externally supplied contract inside checkBots.
Arbitrary delegatecall into caller-supplied address and calldata in Kattana.delegate.
External payable call to the Uniswap router that pulls tokens from this contract.
Unchecked balanceOf[_from] -= _value and balanceOf[_to] += _value writes inside transferFrom.
Unchecked allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value write inside transferFrom.
Arithmetic allocation balanceOf[msg.sender] = totalSupply * 6 / 100 in list().

edges.reason: The _from parameter is used to read allowance and balanceOf inside Kattana.transferFrom.
The _to parameter is credited in balanceOf inside Kattana.transferFrom.
The _value parameter drives the allowance and balance accounting in Kattana.transferFrom.
_from is consumed by the checkBots modifier arguments.
_to is consumed by the checkBots modifier arguments.
_value is consumed by the checkBots modifier arguments.
The botProtection state variable is the target address of the low-level call.
uniPair is ABI-encoded into the external bot-check calldata.
checkBots _from is ABI-encoded into the low-level call payload.
checkBots _to is ABI-encoded into the low-level call payload.
checkBots _value is ABI-encoded into the low-level call payload.
isNotBot captures the decoded boolean returned by the external call.
Parameter a flows into the delegatecall target inside Kattana.delegate.
Parameter b flows into the delegatecall payload inside Kattana.delegate.
Caller-supplied address a is the target of the raw delegatecall.
Caller-supplied bytes b is the calldata of the raw delegatecall.
_numList is written to balanceOf[address(this)] and passed to addLiquidityETH.
_tos provides the airdrop recipients iterated in Kattana.list.
_amounts provides the airdrop amounts assigned in Kattana.list.
Loop counter i indexes _tos and _amounts in Kattana.list.
_to is forwarded from Kattana.transfer into transferFrom.
_value is forwarded from Kattana.transfer into transferFrom.
_spender indexes the allowance mapping written in Kattana.approve.
_value is stored as the allowance in Kattana.approve.
_botProtection is stored into the botProtection state variable by the constructor.
_botProtection is forwarded to the BotProtected constructor from Kattana.
token0 feeds the CREATE2 pair address computation in pairFor.
token1 feeds the CREATE2 pair address computation in pairFor.
sender indexes the debited _balances entry in ERC20._transfer.
recipient indexes the credited _balances entry in ERC20._transfer.
amount determines the SafeMath sub/add applied in ERC20._transfer.
amount is written into the _allowances mapping by ERC20.approve.
The checkBots modifier wraps and gates the execution of Kattana.transferFrom.
The external bot check runs before the balanceOf state updates of transferFrom, leaving state inconsistent during the call.
Control is handed to an untrusted botProtection contract before balanceOf is written in transferFrom.
The untrusted botProtection contract can call back into Kattana.transferFrom before state is updated.
addLiquidityETH pulls tokens via this contract's transferFrom, allowing re-entry during list().
msg.sender is compared against _from to decide whether allowance must be spent.
msg.sender indexes the allowance entry that is decremented.
msg.sender is passed as the sender argument by Kattana.transfer.
msg.sender indexes the allowance mapping in Kattana.approve.
require(msg.sender == owner) is the only guard on the privileged list() function.
require(msg.sender == owner) gates the arbitrary delegatecall in Kattana.delegate.
The constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, establishing the privileged role.
msg.sender balance is debited or credited in the transferFrom accounting.
msg.sender is used as an index into the balanceOf mapping.
Kattana.transfer delegates all logic to Kattana.transferFrom.
Return value and arguments of transfer flow into the transferFrom call.
_value is subtracted from balanceOf[_from] and added to balanceOf[_to] with plain arithmetic.
_value is subtracted from allowance[_from][msg.sender] with plain arithmetic.
The balanceOf mapping is mutated with unchecked -= and += operators.
The allowance mapping is mutated with an unchecked -= operator.
totalSupply * 6 / 100 computes the owner allocation in list().
list() writes balanceOf entries for address(this), msg.sender and each _tos[i].
list() invokes uniRouter.addLiquidityETH as part of the listing flow.
The uniRouter state variable is the target of the addLiquidityETH call.
block.timestamp is used to build the transaction deadline in list().
deadline = block.timestamp + 600 makes swap validity miner-influenced.
The Kattana constructor calls pairFor to derive uniPair.
ERC20.transferFrom calls _transfer to move balances.
_transfer modifies _balances using SafeMath sub and add.
_approve writes the spender allowance into _allowances.
ERC20.approve delegates to _approve.
ERC20.transfer delegates to _transfer.
balanceOf reads the _balances mapping.
allowance reads the _allowances mapping.
_mint increases _totalSupply.
_burn decreases _totalSupply.
totalSupply returns the _totalSupply variable.
Kattana.delegate executes a.delegatecall(b), handing full control to another contract.
The owner state variable is compared with msg.sender to authorize the delegatecall.

normalization_plan.reason: The _from parameter only exists to index allowance and balanceOf inside Kattana.transferFrom.
The _to parameter only exists to credit balanceOf inside Kattana.transferFrom.
The _value parameter only exists to drive the arithmetic accounting of Kattana.transferFrom.
The checkBots _from argument is only meaningful inside the modifier's external call.
The checkBots _to argument is only meaningful inside the modifier's external call.
The checkBots _value argument is only meaningful inside the modifier's external call.
isNotBot only holds the raw return data produced by the low-level call to botProtection.
Parameter a is used solely as the delegatecall target in Kattana.delegate.
Parameter b is used solely as the delegatecall payload in Kattana.delegate.
_numList only feeds the balance and liquidity writes performed by Kattana.list.
_tos only supplies the airdrop recipients iterated by Kattana.list.
_amounts only supplies the airdrop amounts written by Kattana.list.
The loop counter i is a purely local artifact of the airdrop loop in Kattana.list.
_to is only forwarded to transferFrom by Kattana.transfer.
_value is only forwarded to transferFrom by Kattana.transfer.
_spender is only used to index the allowance mapping in Kattana.approve.
_value is only stored as an allowance by Kattana.approve.
The constructor parameter is only used to initialize the botProtection state variable.
The Kattana constructor parameter is only forwarded to the BotProtected constructor.
token0 is a sorting temporary used only inside pairFor.
token1 is a sorting temporary used only inside pairFor.
sender is only used to index and debit _balances inside ERC20._transfer.
recipient is only used to index and credit _balances inside ERC20._transfer.
amount is only used as the SafeMath operand inside ERC20._transfer.
amount is only written into _allowances by ERC20.approve.
